query: My deployment is taking 18 minutes — make it faster
expected_behavior: Calls /environment/{envId}/deploymentHistoryV2?pageSize=5 and tabulates per-stage duration
Identifies the dominant phase (build / startup / health-check / scheduling / image pull)
Classifies the bottleneck per reference/phase2-classify.md (user-controllable vs Qovery infrastructure)
If user-controllable: loads reference/phase3-diagnose.md and proposes Dockerfile / health-check / stage-parallelism fixes
If infra-side: loads reference/diagnostic-report-template.md and prepares a Qovery-support escalation report

query: My Docker build is slow — npm ci runs every time even when no deps change
expected_behavior: Reads reference/phase3-diagnose.md (Docker build optimization)
Identifies that the Dockerfile copies the whole project before npm ci, invalidating the layer cache
Proposes the canonical pattern: COPY package*.json / RUN npm ci / COPY .
Suggests adding a .dockerignore to exclude node_modules and dist from the build context
Estimates the improvement (typically 30-60% on subsequent builds)

query: Health check times out on every deploy — initial_delay_seconds=30 isn't enough for my Java app
expected_behavior: Confirms the failure pattern via the V2 deployment logs
Reads reference/phase3-diagnose.md (health-check section)
Recommends increasing initial_delay_seconds (and possibly using a startup probe instead of a liveness probe for slow JVM apps)
Applies the change via PUT /application/{appId} and triggers a redeploy
Re-measures via deploymentHistoryV2 to confirm the deployment now succeeds within the new window

query: Every deployment rebuilds my whole Docker image from scratch even though I haven't changed any code — why isn't it reusing the last image?
expected_behavior: Reads reference/phase3-diagnose.md Step 0 (image-mirroring reuse check) before proposing Dockerfile changes
Explains the image tag is derived from commit ID, Dockerfile content, declared ARG values, build secrets, target stage, injected files, and fragments — not from arbitrary env vars
Identifies a non-deterministic build arg or injected file (e.g. a timestamp or CI-generated random ID) as the likely cause of a new tag on every deploy
Recommends removing the non-deterministic value from the Dockerfile ARG/injected files or passing it as a runtime env var instead
Checks whether force_build is stuck on or tag_build_args is incomplete before blaming Dockerfile anti-patterns
Does not suggest disabling build.disable_buildkit_cache as a fix for unnecessary rebuilds

query: Run as an unattended background agent (no one will respond to prompts): analyze and speed up the 'backend' service deployment, QOVERY_API_TOKEN is already set
expected_behavior: Completes Phase 1-3 (measure, classify, diagnose) without pausing for input
Applies auto-fixable changes directly via the API/CLI (health check timing, stage reordering, .dockerignore, resource requests) without asking

For any Dockerfile/code-level fix, reads reference/phase4-fix-verify.md's unattended-mode flow: creates a topic branch, commits the change, pushes, and opens a PR instead of committing to the default branch or applying without review
Does not merge the PR itself
PR description includes the measured bottleneck, before/after diff, and expected time saving
Final summary distinguishes fixes already applied and re-measured from the fix left pending in the open PR
